about: I'm a software security engineer who enjoys designing systems that are safe by default — from authentication flows and access control to threat modelling and vulnerability prioritisation.
Alongside engineering, I work on education technology: building tools that make assessment fairer and learning more accessible, and judging and mentoring EdTech teams around the world.
